description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notify the Names of Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Chairman, Vice Chairman for the Districts of Ampara, Batticaloa and Trincomalee.
reasoning: This gazette exclusively contains election results and declarations for local authorities (Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen) as declared under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers "Election results and declarations" and "Candidate nominations and registrations." While it names individuals, the context is purely electoral and does not involve government personnel appointments or portfolio assignments, so government classification types (1-3) do not take precedence.
